fullData.title: Subtracting on a Number Line
fullData.subject: Arithmetic

problem.statement: Maya has 45 beads in her art box. She uses 12 beads to make a bracelet. Use the number line to start at 45 and count backward by tens and ones to find out how many beads Maya has left.

fullData.solutionStrategy: Count backward on the number line by jumping back the tens first and then the ones.

content.altText: A number line from 30 to 50 with a starting point at 45 and an arrow jumping back 10 to 35.

annotations.steps: I start at 45 on the number line and jump backward by 10 to land on 35.
annotations.strategy: I notice that breaking 12 into 10 and 2 makes it easier to jump backward in friendly chunks.
annotations.misconceptions: Start at the given number. Count the moves after it, not the starting mark.
annotations.connections: This connects to place value, showing how to subtract tens before subtracting ones.
annotations.narrative: Since $12$ is $10 + 2$, begin at the point labeled Start at $45$ on the number line and jump back $10$ to reach Minus 10 at $35$ ($45 - 10 = 35$).

content.altText: A number line from 30 to 50 showing a jump backward of 2 from 35 to 33.

annotations.steps: Jump back 2 ones from 35 to land on 33.
annotations.strategy: I take away the ones last because it keeps my counting simple.
annotations.misconceptions: Start at the given number. Count the moves after it, not the starting mark.
annotations.connections: Counting backward on a number line is the same as taking away objects.
annotations.narrative: From $35$, jump back the remaining $2$ ones to reach Minus 2 at $33$ ($35 - 2 = 33$), which shows Maya has $33$ beads left.

specs.title: Subtract tens on number line
specs.pedagogicalGoal: Decompose the subtrahend into tens and ones to visualize jumping backward 10 along the number line.
specs.seedNotes: Construct a number line from 30 to 50 starting at 45 and showing a jump back of 10 to land at 35 with equation 45 - 10 = 35.

specs.title: Subtract remaining ones to finish
specs.pedagogicalGoal: Complete the subtraction by counting back the remaining ones to arrive at the final quantity.
specs.seedNotes: Show a second jump back of 2 units from 35 to reach the final answer 33 with equation 35 - 2 = 33.
